author: executing agent
note: Start with Flint Litany for the clearest change in drawing language, and Lacquer & Ash for pale cloth against a raw dark arena. Moonchalk Tempest is the quieter nocturnal alternative. Verdigris offers finer ritual linework; Ragged and Granite have useful material ideas but weaker medium separation. Coal and Cinder arenas are capped camera rejects. This is a comparison order, not a choice or approval; all final camera/figure feel remains yours.
limitations: Painted camera angle and body bounds are approximate, not engine-calibrated.
Some final figures occupy 5-8 percent rather than exactly 6 percent of height.
Enemy counts, detached wards and medium fidelity vary; defects remain on each card.
Portrait faces deliberately share one textual control identity; some remain closer in paint handling than intended.
No motion, integrated performance or owner feel has been measured.
